import.title: Import products
import.intro: Upload a spreadsheet exported as CSV. Rows are matched on barcode, so importing the same file again updates instead of duplicating.

import.unknownSuppliers: Suppliers not in your list yet: {names}. Add them first, or clear the column.
import.formatBody: One row per product. Only a name column is required — everything else is optional. Commas, semicolons and Excel exports all work.
import.formatColumns: Recognised columns: name, barcode, sku, unit, cost, price, min_stock, shelf_life_days, supplier.
